summary: Kimi K3 through the Claude Code CLI, pointed at Moonshot's endpoint.

auto.$comment: Claude Code's auto mode: a second model (the classifier) reviews each action before it runs instead of the user. NOT workspace-scoped — the preset this replaced was labelled "Auto-approve workspace edits", which described Codex's sandbox rung and misdescribed this one (MC-2210). Reads and in-project edits skip the classifier; shell, network, out-of-project writes and subagent spawns are reviewed.
auto.label: Auto — the classifier reviews each action

launch.$comment: Runs the claude binary redirected at Moonshot's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, per Moonshot's official 'Use Kimi in Claude Code' guide. Model tier is driven entirely by the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL map (all tiers pin kimi-k3, matching the guide), so no modelSelection is declared — same pattern as the Z.AI runtime.

contextInjection.$comment: Runs the same `claude` binary as the claude-code runtime, redirected at another endpoint, so it takes the same --append-system-prompt-file flag. Verified against the installed CLI 2.1.263.

installTargets.$comment: restartRequired verified false on 2026-07-29: a skill directory created while `claude` was already running appeared in its /skill picker without a restart. kimi-claude and zai run the same `claude` binary against the same .claude/skills, so the finding covers all three.

agentStateSpec.$comment: Byte-for-byte the claude-code spec: this runtime is the same `claude` binary against Moonshot's endpoint, so it fires the same lifecycle hooks and shares the same .claude/settings.local.json registration. Formerly admitted by a harnessId fallback in core; declared here so the capability is explicit per plugin. FileChanged (Claude Code 2.1.266) is registered for the agent CHANGELIST, not the phase: its payload is file_path + event (change|add|unlink) with no diff, so the reporter forwards it as a path-only touch and an edit made through Bash, a formatter or codegen still reaches the ledger at file level. It fires ONLY for paths a hook has armed with hookSpecificOutput.watchPaths — nothing arms any today, so it is declared register:false: the reporter already reads the event, and the day something arms watch paths the registration is one flag away. Two reasons it stays unwritten until that arming is decided: arming a whole repository would spawn a reporter per file change (a git checkout is thousands), and the declared phase is `thinking` only because the event table requires one — a watcher event firing while the session was idle would move the phase, which is the wrong kind of wrong.

capabilities.$comment: resumeSession/sessionIdFromCaller mirror claude-code and zai: resume is the claude binary's own local session store (--session-id at launch, --resume on relaunch), which is endpoint-independent — the same verified path the Z.AI runtime uses.
